changes.docs/keeping.md:
# Keeping the light

The lamp is checked at dusk, and again at midnight.
A dim lamp is logged and reported before the watch ends.

messages.text: The lamp only knows whether it is on. Give it a brightness, and make it say when it has gone dim, so the keeper sees it before the watch ends.

Read `Sources/Lamp.swift` and `docs/keeping.md`. The lamp is a single boolean today, and nothing in the repository measures it, so there is no number to be consistent with. I will give it `lumens`, derive `lit` from it rather than letting the two disagree, and add `isDim` under four hundred, which is the figure the keeping notes already use for the dusk check.
Four hundred is right. The keeper also wants the dim reading written down, not just shown.

Then the log belongs to the watch rather than to the lamp, so the lamp stays a reading and the watch keeps the record.

- `Lamp.light(to:)` sets the brightness and derives `lit` from it.
- `Lamp.isDim` is true below four hundred, and only while lit.
- `Watch.log(_:)` keeps the entries the keeper reads at the end of the night.

Three files changed. The dusk sentence in `docs/keeping.md` now says what happens at midnight too, because the old wording promised one check a night.
Three tests cover the lamp, and one of them asserted that `lit` could be set on its own. It cannot any more, so I rewrote it to set a brightness and read `lit` back. The other two pass unchanged.
Good. What happens if the keeper sets a negative brightness?

Today it would be stored and `lit` would come out false, which reads as off rather than as broken. A lamp cannot be minus two hundred lumens, so I would rather refuse it than record it. Two ways out: clamp to zero, or make `light(to:)` throw.

Clamping is quieter and matches how the dusk check is written, and nothing in the repository catches errors from the keeper's own panel yet, so I would clamp and leave a line in the watch saying the reading was refused.
Clamp it, and write the refusal into the watch.
Clamped, and the watch records `brightness refused: -200` with the time it came in. Running the tests on the changed files now.
How often does the bell ring in fog?
Every thirty seconds, from `Sources/Bell.swift`. Nothing in the repository makes that configurable yet.
Make the fog interval a setting.
Done, and the default stays thirty seconds. Ready to read.
